'''2003 Minnesota State Championship Shane Engelking DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Shane Engelking]] at [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]], finishing 2nd; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by shane "elvis solo" engelking (2003-10-16).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30563 The Icebox]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071209040040/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30563 Internet Archive]</ref>
